subject: Next steps + MAP: Horizon Cloud evaluation & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@horizon-cloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed MAP (Horizon Cloud)

Hi Sasha — thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: inference at scale for customer-facing search and summarization.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency under 150ms median for 2k token flows, predictable unit cost, SOC2 + contract SLAs, and deployment flexibility (VPC option).
- Timeline target: procurement sign-off by end of June (you mentioned fiscal priorities).

Stakeholder map (from our conversation):
- Economic buyer: Elliot Meyer (CFO) — final sign-off on budget and contract.
- Technical evaluator: Sasha Ivanov — lead for POC and performance validation.
- Security/procurement: procurement@horizon-cloud.com — questionnaire + vendor setup.

Proposed MAP (v1) — milestones & owners:
1) Security package & answers (Ben) — deliver by 2026-05-15. Attachment: redwood_security_summary.pdf
2) Technical POC (Connor) — schedule week of 2026-05-25, 2-week run. Attachment: horizon_map_v1.xlsx (POC scope tab)
3) Legal review & redlines (Laura) — target turnaround 10 business days after contract sent
4) Procurement vendor setup & PO (Horizon Procurement) — target complete by 2026-06-18
5) Executive approval (Elliot) — anticipated final sign-off by 2026-06-25

Next steps I propose from our side:
- I’ll send the security pack and the MAP spreadsheet (attached).
- Connor will reach out to schedule POC sessions and collect perf samples.
- Laura will prepare the standard Redwood starter contract and be available for redlines.

Can you confirm the stakeholder list and whether those milestone dates align with your internal expectations? Also, who should I loop from legal (if different from procurement)?

Thanks — will follow up with the attachments and a shared Drive link.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: redwood_security_summary.pdf, horizon_map_v1.xlsx

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@horizon-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Horizon Cloud Procurement <procurement@horizon-cloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed MAP (Horizon Cloud)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming:
- Economic buyer is indeed Elliot Meyer (CFO) — I’ll intro you via email once we have the POC scope locked.
- Procurement contact is correct; I’ve cc’d them here.

A few clarifications:
- For the POC, we’ll need a short performance run (3 sample workflows) and an architecture walkthrough. Connor’s access will need a staging API key and light traffic (no production data).
- Typical procurement gating at our org: security questionnaire -> legal contract -> finance PO. Legal usually takes ~7–10 business days for standard SaaS agreements; procurement owns vendor checklist (SOC2, DPA, IP terms).

POC availability: week of 2026-05-25 works for us.

If procurement needs anything else upfront, they can flag it. Otherwise we’re aligned to the proposed milestones.

—Sasha
Director, Platform Engineering
Horizon Cloud
sasha@horizon-cloud.com

From: Horizon Cloud Procurement <procurement@horizon-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@horizon-cloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding docs & initial ask — Redwood Inference

Ben — procurement here. Thanks for looping us in. To begin vendor onboarding we need the following deliverables: 

1) Completed security questionnaire (we’ll send via secure link)
2) SOC 2 Type II report (or letter of attestation)
3) Data Processing Addendum (DPA) — we’ll review your standard DPA
4) Vendor risk profile: summary of data flows, storage regions, and retention policies
5) Completed vendor form (attached template)

Timeline expectation: once we receive the materials and legal receives the contract, procurement typically completes vendor setup and issues the PO within 7–14 business days, assuming no major exceptions. I’m attaching our PO template for your review: horizon_po_template.docx

Please confirm when the security package and SOC2 report can be provided. We prefer links to hosted reports or a secure upload.

Regards,
Maria Gonzales
Senior Procurement Manager
Horizon Cloud
procurement@horizon-cloud.com

Attachments: horizon_po_template.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Horizon Cloud Procurement <procurement@horizon-cloud.com>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@horizon-cloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding docs & initial ask — Redwood Inference

Maria/Sasha — thanks, and great to meet you Maria. Quick hits from our side: 
- Security package (SOC2 summary + answers) attached (redwood_security_summary.pdf). We will provide the full SOC2 report via secure link by 2026-05-15.
- I’ve attached a MAP spreadsheet (horizon_map_v1.xlsx) with an updated milestone table, owners, and suggested dates.
- Connor will reach out today to schedule the POC onboarding session (staging key + perf test plan).
- Laura is on copy for contracts — she’ll pick up redlines as they arrive.

Proposed updated dates (MAP v1.1):
- Security package delivered: 2026-05-15 (Ben)
- POC run: 2026-05-25 to 2026-06-08 (Connor + Sasha)
- Contract draft to Horizon legal: 2026-05-20 (Laura)
- Vendor setup & PO: target complete by 2026-06-18 (Procurement)
- Exec approval & sign: target by 2026-06-25 (Elliot)

If those still look reasonable I’ll mark them in the shared MAP and convert to a simple milestone tracker we can update weekly. Open to moving any date you need.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Connor in with your team.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments: horizon_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_security_summary.pdf

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@horizon-cloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Horizon Cloud Procurement <procurement@horizon-cloud.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Elliot Meyer <elliot.meyer@horizon-cloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + MAP: Horizon Cloud evaluation & procurement timeline

All — thanks for the updates and for putting everything in a single tracker. Confirming acceptance of the MAP v1.1 dates. A couple of items for visibility: 
- Our decision criteria doc (short list) will be shared with you by end of day 2026-05-18 — will include cost targets and perf KPIs for the POC.
- I’ll introduce you to Elliot next week for a brief budget alignment (10–15 min).
- Procurement: if you can confirm the secure upload link for SOC2 by EOD 2026-05-15 that would be helpful.

Connor — please reach out to schedule the POC kickoff (we prefer Fri 2026-05-22 or Tue 2026-05-26).

Sasha
Director, Platform Engineering, Horizon Cloud
